personality: 3 Editorial structure with 6 Glass / Luxe surfaces
personality_one_liner: A light, airy, and hyper-premium concierge experience that combines the typographic elegance of a luxury brochure with the fast, tactile clarity of a modern fintech app.

spacing.rule: Generous, breathable rhythm. Whitespace is a premium asset. Keep margins consistent (lg/xl) and avoid crowded components.

do's: Use frosted glass on the bottom tab bar.
Apply glass overlay on the sticky bottom CTA bar in the booking screen.
Use glass headers for the bottom sheets (Rate Modal, Accept Order sheet).
dont's: Do not blur standard list rows or static form inputs.
Do not use glass backgrounds on top of empty or plain color backgrounds; ensure there's overlapping content underneath to justify the blur.

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Email/password authentication with a prominent segmented control to switch between Customer and Company roles.

states.error: Standard text error below inputs, no aggressive red cards.

screens.layout: Large editorial serif header at the top. Segmented control for role selection. Single column form inputs with floating labels. Sticky primary CTA at the bottom. Use generous vertical spacing.

screens.name: Customer - Book
screens.purpose: The primary concierge interface for customers to select a vehicle, input ride details, and view pricing.

states.error: Error boundary with 'Unable to load fleet' and retry button.

screens.layout: Top section: A visually striking horizontal carousel of car categories (VIP, Luxury, Normal) using edge-to-edge images with a bottom-to-top gradient scrim for text legibility. Middle section: Clean, icon-led input fields for Pickup/Drop-off (with a swap icon), Date/Time, and Notes in soft white cards (surfaceSecondary) against the warm background (surface). Bottom section: A sticky frosted glass container holding the live pricing, surge badges (brandTertiary chips), and a primary 'Book Ride' CTA.

screens.name: Customer - My Rides
screens.purpose: A timeline of the user's booking history and active requests.

states.empty: Illustration of a key or empty road with 'No rides booked yet' and a CTA to Book.

screens.layout: Vertical list of soft cards (surfaceSecondary). Each card displays route, date, and a prominent status badge. If 'Accepted' or 'Completed', embed a sub-card showing the Driver's profile picture, name, and car plate. Include a 'Rate' button on completed rides that triggers the Rate Modal.

screens.name: Company - Orders
screens.purpose: Admin dashboard to process incoming ride requests and view live operational stats.

states.empty: Illustration with 'No active requests at the moment.'

screens.layout: Top section: 2-column grid of stat tiles (e.g., Pending Count, Avg Rating) using surfaceSecondary with shadow tier 2. Below stats: Sticky horizontal scrollable filter chips (All, Pending, Accepted, Rejected). Main content: List of incoming order cards. Tapping 'Accept' triggers a bottom sheet to assign a driver.

screens.name: Rate Modal
screens.purpose: Bottom sheet for customer to rate completed rides.
screens.layout: gorhom/bottom-sheet overlay. Large elegant typography asking for feedback, 5 large tappable Phosphor star icons, followed by a multiline text input for comments. 'Submit' CTA pinned to keyboard.

hero_car_luxury.alt: Black Mercedes S-Class representing Luxury car category

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Light Premium aesthetic. Backgrounds should use the warm off-white (surface #FBF9F6), while cards are pure white (surfaceSecondary #FFFFFF) with soft shadows (shadow_tier 2) to establish depth and elegance.
Do NOT use Material gray backgrounds or flat borders. The design relies on shadow and whitespace to separate content.
All headings must use the provided display serif font (Cormorant Garamond) to maintain the editorial/brochure feel, while body and UI controls use the sans-serif (Geist) for clarity.
Use Phosphor icons heavily: car types, status badges, price items, driver details, and stat tiles all require clear icons. Keep icon weights consistent (Regular or Light).
For the booking screen, ensure the bottom CTA (price + book button) sits within a sticky frosted glass container (using expo-blur) layered over the scrollable content.
Never use blue or purple anywhere in the app. Status colors are provided, and brand emphasis is strictly gold (brandPrimary).
Remember to include RTL-safe logical properties (paddingStart, alignEnd, etc.) as the app will eventually support an Arabic toggle.
Apply gradient scrims (bottom-to-top, transparent to 70% surfaceInverse) to the bottom of all car carousel images to ensure text legibility over the photos.
